mapper.sql: id, quality_no, task_id, grain_year, grain_grade, grain_price, deduction, deduction_price, warehouse_id, quality_result, remarks, add_user, add_time, update_user, update_time
mapper.select:
select tfqi.id, tfqi.quality_no as qualityNo, tfqi.grain_year as grainYear, tfqi.grain_grade as grainGrade, tfqi.grain_price as grainPrice, tfqi.deduction, tfqi.deduction_price as deductionPrice, sw.warehouse_name as warehouseName, tfqi.quality_result as qualityResult, tfqi.add_time as addTime, tf.card_no as cardNo, tfsi.grain_variety as grainVariety from task_flow_quality_item tfqi left join task_flow_sample_item tfsi on tfqi.task_id = tfsi.task_id left join task_flow tf on tfqi.task_id =tf.id left join sts_warehouse sw ON sw.id = tfqi.warehouse_id
and tfqi.add_user=#{userId}
and (to_char(tfqi.add_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startTime})
and (to_char(tfqi.add_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endTime})
order by tfqi.add_time desc

select a.id, a.quality_no, a.task_id, a.grain_year, a.grain_grade, a.grain_price, a.deduction, a.deduction_price, b.warehouse_name as warehouseId, a.quality_result, a.remarks, c.name as addUser, a.add_time, a.update_user, a.update_time from task_flow_quality_item a left join sts_warehouse b on a.warehouse_id = b.id left join base_user_info c on a.add_user = c.id
a.task_id = #{taskId}
